description: Headless commerce framework layer — products/variants/carts/line_items/orders/payments/webhook_events schema, Stripe PaymentIntent checkout, signature-verified idempotent Stripe webhooks.

apiRoutes: POST /api/carts/:id/checkout (creates Order + Stripe PaymentIntent, returns client_secret)
dataModels: Variant (productId, sku, priceCents, currency, inventoryQty, attributes jsonb)
Order (cartId, customerId, subtotalCents, taxCents, totalCents, status: pending|paid|fulfilled|refunded|cancelled, placedAt, paidAt)
Payment (orderId, processor: stripe, processorId piId, amountCents, status, capturedAt)
WebhookEvent (processor, eventId UNIQUE, type, receivedAt, processedAt, payloadJson) — idempotency key
integrations: Stripe PaymentIntents for checkout (confirm on client with client_secret)
architectureNotes: Prices captured on LineItem at add-to-cart time — product price changes don't retroactively alter carts
Inventory decremented on ORDER PLACEMENT (not payment success) to prevent overselling during payment processing
Webhook idempotency: webhook_events.event_id is UNIQUE; duplicate Stripe deliveries no-op instead of double-crediting the order
Amounts are integer cents, currency per-row (Stripe minimum amount is also in cents)
firstSteps: Copy .env.example to .env and fill in DATABASE_URL (postgres://...) and STRIPE_SECRET_KEY (sk_test_...)
Run `pnpm db:generate` then `pnpm db:migrate` to create the schema in your database
Run `pnpm dev` — server starts on PORT (default 8105); confirm with GET /health
For local webhook testing: `stripe listen --forward-to localhost:8105/webhooks/stripe` and set STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET to the printed whsec_ value
To add a product: INSERT into products + variants tables (priceCents is integer cents, currency is 3-char ISO code)
Extend src/db/schema.ts for new fields, then re-run db:generate + db:migrate — Drizzle infers the migration diff automatically
gotchas: Stripe webhook signatures MUST be verified with the raw request body BEFORE JSON parsing. Parsing first, then verifying against a re-serialized body, fails because of whitespace differences.
Webhooks MUST be idempotent. Stripe retries on any non-2xx AND on timeouts even after you succeed. Use webhook_events.event_id UNIQUE as the lock.

PCI-DSS: NEVER store card numbers (PAN), CVV, or full track data. Only Stripe's payment_intent_id / payment_method_id. PCI-SAQ A requires card data never touches your server — use Stripe.js on the client, server only sees tokens.
Oversell bug: decrement inventory in the SAME transaction as order placement. Decrementing on webhook 'payment_succeeded' leaves a race where two customers claim the last unit.
Price drift: snapshot the unit_price onto LineItem at add-to-cart. Reading product.price at checkout means catalog edits retroactively charge customers more (or less).
Tax is jurisdictional and this scaffold does NOT compute it. Integrate TaxJar / Stripe Tax / Avalara before going live; don't hard-code a percentage.
Refunds are NEW records (refund payment with negative amount OR separate Refund entity), not UPDATEs to the original payment. Financial auditability demands it.
Cart expiration / abandoned cart cleanup must NOT release inventory that was decremented on order placement — inventory is released by cancelling the order explicitly.
Currency minor units differ: JPY has 0 decimals, USD has 2, TND has 3. amountCents isn't literally 'cents' for every currency — follow Stripe's currency docs.
